title: Understanding the Update Rule
text: The update rule for gradient descent is given by: \( \theta**{(t+1)} $$=$$ \theta**{(t)} - \alpha \cdot \frac{d}{d\theta}L(\theta**{(t)}) \).

title: Substitute Known Values
text: Substitute the known values into the update rule: \( $$7$$ $$=$$ $$11$$ - $$1$$ \cdot \frac{d}{d\theta}L(\theta**{(1)}) \).

title: Solve for the Gradient
text: Rearrange the equation to solve for \( \frac{d}{d\theta}L(\theta**{(1)}) \): \( \frac{d}{d\theta}L(\theta**{(1)}) $$=$$ $$11$$ - $$7$$ \).
